pr_body:
Fixes #97873.

We aimed in #95691 to preserve compatibility with the previous semantics of `destroy_tenant()`, but we failed to do so and there was no test to tell us about the mistake.

This commit fixes both.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/98209)

issue_context.title: sql: crdb_internal.destroy_tenant no longer destroys active tenants
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

In https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/95691, it is noted that we need to invoke `ALTER TENANT STOP SERVICE` before dropping a tenant with the exception of `crdb_internal.destroy_tenant` for backwards compatibility with CC. That's not the case based on experiments on the following revision:

```
Build Tag:        v23.1.0-alpha.3-377-g13c58f6215
Build Time:       2023/02/27 07:04:17
Distribution:     CCL
Platform:         linux amd64 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu)
Go Version:       go1.19.4
C Compiler:       gcc 6.5.0
Build Commit ID:  13c58f621519794e775b7cfc4d8b557bc99eeca0
Build Type:       release
```

**To Reproduce**

```
demo@127.0.0.1:26259/defaultdb> select * from crdb_internal.create_tenant(1000);
  crdb_internal.create_tenant
-------------------------------
                         1000
(1 row)

Time: 77ms total (execution 76ms / network 1ms)

demo@127.0.0.1:26259/defaultdb> select * from crdb_internal.destroy_tenant(1000);
ERROR: crdb_internal.destroy_tenant(): destroying tenant: cannot use tenant service mode external with data state drop
demo@127.0.0.1:26259/defaultdb> alter tenant 'tenant-1000' stop service;
ALTER TENANT SERVICE

Time: 14ms total (execution 13ms / network 1ms)

demo@127.0.0.1:26259/defaultdb> select * from crdb_internal.destroy_tenant(1000);
  crdb_internal.destroy_tenant
--------------------------------
                          1000
(1 row)

Time: 21ms total (execution 20ms / network 1ms)
```

Note that I'm using docker with `cockroach demo` here (+ switching into the system tenant), but it shouldn't affect the environment:

```
docker run -it <internal CC docker registry>/cockroach:v23.1.0-alpha.3-377-g13c58f6215 demo --demo-locality=region=us-east1,az=1:region=us-central1,az=2:region=us-west2,az=3 --nodes=3
```

**Expected behavior**

I'd have expected that destroy_tenant would just drop the tenant entry like before.

This is what happens in *v22.1.5*:

```
# Server version: CockroachDB CCL v22.1.5 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, built 2022/07/28 14:58:04, go1.17.11) (same version as client)
# Cluster ID: 2aa2179d-322f-4f26-a104-75c3b90114d6
# Organization: Cockroach Demo
#
# Enter \? for a brief introduction.
#
demo@127.0.0.1:26257/movr> select * from crdb_internal.create_tenant(1000);
  crdb_internal.create_tenant
-------------------------------
                         1000
(1 row)


Time: 36ms total (execution 36ms / network 1ms)

demo@127.0.0.1:26257/movr> select * from crdb_internal.destroy_tenant(1000);
  crdb_internal.destroy_tenant
--------------------------------
                          1000
(1 row)


Time: 10ms total (execution 10ms / network 0ms)
```




Jira issue: CRDB-24937
Epic: CRDB-23559
